extension.summary: Patches Aeon Nox 5 for CU LRC Lyrics + DC Artist Artwork DL compatibility
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons (after skin.aeon.nox.5 and, ideally, script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart are installed). Patches up to 3 of skin.aeon.nox.5's own files: (1) 1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - hides the topbar.png control that draws a dark band over lyrics text, and adds the rotating-fanart background control used by DC Artist Artwork DL; (2) 1080i/MusicVisualisation.xml - hides the skin's own static fanart background so it can't cover the rotating one; (3) 1080i/Font.xml - fixes missing Slovak/Czech diacritics in 2 of the 5 lyrics display fonts. Each file gets a one-time backup (.bak) before patching; re-running is a no-op for anything already applied. Restart Kodi afterwards for the changes to take effect. Only tested against Aeon Nox 5 on CoreELEC (Omega) - refuses to touch anything on other skins since the target files won't match.
extension.news: 1.5.0: seek-progress overlay repositioned to the top of the screen and widened to match the translation panel's width/left margin (45,1830 instead of 360,1200), instead of the centered box over the middle of the lyrics text. 1.4.0: adds a seek-progress overlay (group id 140) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - a translucent progress bar plus elapsed/total time and the +/-amount just seeked, shown briefly on left/right during timed or untimed lyrics, using the skin's own osd/texturebg_cache.png + osd/midtexture.png textures and Player.Progress/Player.Time/Player.Duration infolabels so the bar itself needs no per-frame Python updates. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.11.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.3.0: now patches skin.aeon.nox.5.skinbase too, not just skin.aeon.nox.5 - skinbase is Aeon Nox 5's own pristine copy of itself, used by the skin's built-in "reset to default" feature, and was silently missing all 4 patches (confirmed by direct comparison: none of the 3 patched files matched, and script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml did not exist there at all). A skin reset would have reverted every fix in this addon without warning. 1.2.0: adds a 4th file, script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml - a dedicated, wide window for the lyrics sync-offset slider (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics), instead of reusing the skin's shared DialogSlider.xml (also used for volume/seek/brightness everywhere else in Kodi). Unlike the other 3 patched files, this one is a brand new file this addon introduces rather than an existing file it patches, so it needs no .bak backup. Also adds font_sync to Font.xml for it. 1.1.0: now patches all 3 skin files this repo ships overrides for (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml, MusicVisualisation.xml, Font.xml) in one run with a single combined confirmation, instead of only the lyrics topbar file - the other two were previously manual-copy-only (skin-overrides/) and easy to miss, and script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart now declare this addon as a real <requires> dependency so Kodi installs it alongside them automatically. 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.
